record.bible_text: Thinkest<WH02803><WTH8804> thou this to be right<WH04941>, <FI>that<Fi> thou saidst<WH0559><WTH8804>, My righteousness<WH06664> <FI>is<Fi> more than God's<WH0410>?

I will answer<WH07725><WTH8686><WH04405> thee, and thy companions<WH07453> with thee. <RF>answer...: Heb. return to thee words<Rf>
Look<WH05027><WTH8685> unto the heavens<WH08064>, and see<WH07200><WTH8798>; and behold<WH07789><WTH8798> the clouds<WH07834> <FI>which<Fi> are higher<WH01361><WTH8804> than thou.

If thou sinnest<WH02398><WTH8804>, what doest<WH06466><WTH8799> thou against him? or <FI>if<Fi> thy transgressions<WH06588> be multiplied<WH07231><WTH8804>, what doest<WH06213><WTH8799> thou unto him?
If thou be righteous<WH06663><WTH8804>, what givest<WH05414><WTH8799> thou him? or what receiveth<WH03947><WTH8799> he of thine hand<WH03027>?
Thy wickedness<WH07562> <FI>may hurt<Fi> a man<WH0376> as thou <FI>art<Fi> ; and thy righteousness<WH06666> <FI>may profit<Fi> the son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>.<CM>

By reason of the multitude<WH07230> of oppressions<WH06217> they make <FI>the oppressed<Fi> to cry<WH02199><WTH8686>: they cry out<WH07768><WTH8762> by reason of the arm<WH02220> of the mighty<WH07227>.
But none saith<WH0559><WTH8804>, Where <FI>is<Fi> God<WH0433> my maker<WH06213><WTH8802>, who giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> songs<WH02158> in the night<WH03915>;
Who teacheth<WH0502><WTH8764> us more than the beasts<WH0929> of the earth<WH0776>, and maketh us wiser<WH02449><WTH8762> than the fowls<WH05775> of heaven<WH08064>?
There they cry<WH06817><WTH8799>, but none giveth answer<WH06030><WTH8799>, because<WH06440> of the pride<WH01347> of evil men<WH07451>.
Surely God<WH0410> will not hear<WH08085><WTH8799> vanity<WH07723>, neither will the Almighty<WH07706> regard<WH07789><WTH8799> it.<CM>
Although<WH0637> thou sayest<WH0559><WTH8799> thou shalt not see<WH07789><WTH8799> him, <FI>yet<Fi> judgment<WH01779> <FI>is<Fi> before<WH06440> him; therefore trust<WH02342><WTH8787> thou in him.

But now, because <FI>it is<Fi> not <FI>so<Fi> , he hath visited<WH06485><WTH8804> in his anger<WH0639>; yet he knoweth<WH03045><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> not in great<WH03966> extremity<WH06580>: <RF>he hath: that is, God hath<Rf> <RF>he knoweth: that is, Job knoweth<Rf>
Therefore doth Job<WH0347> open<WH06475><WTH8799> his mouth<WH06310> in vain<WH01892>; he multiplieth<WH03527><WTH8686> words<WH04405> without<WH01097> knowledge<WH01847>.<CM>
